# The @rust_crates//vendor aliases scripts/regen.py generates in addition to those the
# vendored BUILD files use (design R4; milestone M6b), one per line, sorted: the direct
# crates.io deps of the pilots' closures (docs/closure/<pilot>.json, crates_io.direct).
# Their crates, and every crate those depend on, go to third_party/crates/.
